description.zh:
增量备份集下载格式。取值：
- **Native**
- **SQL**
- **CSV**  
- **JSON**

> 默认 Native。
description.en:
The format in which the incremental backup set is downloaded. Valid values:

- **Native**

- **SQL**

- **CSV**

- **JSON**

> Default value: Native.

description.zh: 增量备份集任务ID，可调用[DescribeIncrementBackupList](~~2869833~~)接口获取**BackupSetJobId**。
description.en: The ID of the incremental backup task. To obtain the task ID, you can call the [DescribeIncrementBackupList](~~2869833~~) operation and view the value of the **BackupSetJobId** parameter in the response.

The ID of the incremental backup set. To obtain the backup set ID, you can call the [DescribeIncrementBackupList](~~2869833~~) operation and view the value of the **BackupSetId** parameter in the response.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

title.zh: 创建增量备份集下载任务

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs create-increment-backup-set-download --backup-set-id t4yh0g0g0000 --backup-set-name mysql-bin.000054 --backup-set-data-format Native --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz00000000 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs CreateIncrementBackupSetDownload --region cn-hangzhou --BackupSetName 'mysql-bin.000054' --BackupSetDataFormat Native --BackupSetId t4yh0g0g0000 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz00000000
